packageRules.description: Keep major upgrades visible and separately reviewed.

Chief decision 2026-08-11 (SAFRS_GOVERNANCE_REMEDIATION_PLAN.md Fase 4, option a): automerge patch/minor updates only, and only once CI is green. Major updates are excluded by the rule above and always require manual review. This does NOT replace GitHub branch protection / CODEOWNERS review (see docs/governance/PLATFORM_ACTIVATION.md Step 1) — until that is active, this rule is the only gate on these PRs, so it intentionally stays scoped to patch/minor rather than matching the Fitur #7 request literally.
